findings.charge: The artifact states two incompatible models of its own surface axis and never chooses. previewInstallSurfaces and matrix make 'root' a fourth peer install surface and a term of the evidence cross-product; previewInstallSurfaceNote describes root as the per-role accepted anchor and the air-gap root-chain payload member, which is a three-machine model. No passProperty states the surface cardinality, so the number of columns the retained evidence must cover is undetermined.
evidence: Subject previewInstallSurfaces: ['root','index','core','component']. matrix: 'online/offline/air-gap/removable-media state-machine harness × the four D-002 platforms × root/index/core/component install trust'. All four connectivityClasses say 'per D-002 platform and preview install surface'. EV-1 and EV-3 say 'per preview install surface'; EV-2 says 'on each preview install surface'.

Subject previewInstallSurfaceNote, same object: 'root is the install-scoped accepted anchor and the air-gap root-chain member (v8 bootstrapAnchorCustody / airGapPayload root chain). This specification does not invent TR-ROOT.'

v8 roles carries five roles and marks exactly three 'in G08 install scope': TR-CORE, TR-INDEX, TR-COMPONENT. There is no root role. TR-BUNDLE is 'named; not a required preview shipping surface' and TR-REPAIR is 'DEFERRED with DR-110' — both of which the subject correctly excludes.

v8 machine.discipline: 'One machine per trust role. Roles do not share a single collapsed state. A CORE expiry is not an INDEX expiry.' The subject carries this sentence into previewInstallSurfaceNote but applies it to a four-element list where v8 applies it to three roles.
v8 ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED means 'No accepted root/index snapshot FOR THIS ROLE', so the root is a property of a role's snapshot, not a peer of it.

v8 airGapPayload.mustCarry lists 'root chain' as one of eight PAYLOAD members alongside 'signed index snapshot', 'last-known revocation state', 'expiry information', 'manifests', 'payloads', 'permissions', 'repair material'. A payload member is not an install surface.
v8 offlineRunningPolicy.precedence: 'Evaluate CORE first, then INDEX, then COMPONENT. First fail-closed hit wins.' Its totalDecision enumerates only TR-CORE, TR-INDEX and TR-COMPONENT.
v8 machine.refusalReasonVocabulary carries CONTINUE-CORE-NOT-TRUSTED, CONTINUE-INDEX-NOT-TRUSTED and CONTINUE-COMPONENT-NOT-TRUSTED — three, with no root counterpart.

v8 recoveryAuthorityShape binds root to role rather than beside it: 'oldRootIdentification: the from-root is the last accepted install-scoped root FOR THIS ROLE' and 'oldRootNewRootRoleBinding: the old-root, new-root, and role are bound as one recovery step'.

EV-1 and EV-3 passProperty both close with 'Pass all four platforms and all four connectivity classes' — asserting the cardinality of the platform axis and the connectivity axis while asserting nothing about the surface axis, the one axis in dispute.
findings.whyThisIsNotPedantry: The three EV members are operational: EV-1 demands per-surface histories whose records are the v8 audit shape, whose first field is `role`; EV-3 demands per-surface 'ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED + EV-INSTALL => INSTALL-NOT-TRUSTED'. For the root column there is no `role` value and no ST-* instance, because v8 gives root no machine. A fixture author has exactly two ways to build the root column and the artifact forbids both: mint a root role, which contradicts 'This specification does not invent TR-ROOT'; or fold root into another role's machine, which contradicts EV-1's passProperty 'Roles are not collapsed' and the carried v8 sentence 'A CORE expiry is not an INDEX expiry'. The evidence obligation is therefore not decidable from the specification, under a gate whose waiver rule is 'pass all safety cases' and which the artifact itself declares must have exactByteIntent and passProperty for every member.
refutationAttempted: Argue the four-way list is faithfully carried, since naming v6's scopeRider says 'root/index/core/component install trust' and v8's own g08.scope repeats it. Carrying the phrase is not the defect. v8 uses it as scope prose and then enumerates three everywhere the model becomes operational — roles, machine discipline, offlineRunningPolicy precedence, refusal vocabulary, recovery authority binding. The subject converts the prose into an enumerated evidence axis, which is its own act, and that conversion is where root acquires an obligation v8 cannot satisfy.

Argue previewInstallSurfaceNote already resolves it by naming root as the anchor. It resolves the mechanism, not the axis: the same artifact still lists root as a member of previewInstallSurfaces and as a cross-product term in matrix, and still demands 'per preview install surface' evidence in all three EV members and all four connectivity classes. Description in one field does not retract enumeration in five others.

Argue the ambiguity is harmless because root evidence would be produced either way. It is not: the two readings differ in what a pass requires. Under the four-surface reading a run that produces no standalone root history fails EV-1; under the three-machine reading the same run passes with root carried as each role's anchor and root-chain records. The artifact scores neither.
findings.creditWhereDue: This is not the G09 pattern of a silently dropped limb. The artifact anticipates that attack explicitly in namedExecutesLimbNote ('None may be silently dropped (G09 v1 dropped expiry)'), and all four executes limbs are in fact carried with both fields. The defect here is a different one: an axis stated twice with two cardinalities.
findings.whatWouldLandIt: Choose one model and make it consistent across previewInstallSurfaces, matrix, the four connectivity classes and the three EV members. Either state that the machine axis is TR-INDEX / TR-CORE / TR-COMPONENT with root carried inside each role as the accepted anchor and root-chain payload member — naming the anchor and root-chain records that discharge the file-08 word 'Root' — or, if root is genuinely to be a fourth statused surface, name what fills the v8 audit shape's `role` field for it and reconcile that against 'does not invent TR-ROOT'. Then state the surface cardinality in the EV passProperties beside the platform and connectivity cardinalities already there.

notCharged: EV-2's measures and passProperty score recovery for expiry, revocation and quorum loss (three), while its exactByteIntent additionally admits ST-STALE-REVOCATION as a recovery source state. Stale-revocation is a v8 state rather than one of the four naming-v6 executes limbs, and EV-1 retains it as history with OD-112-2 held reserved, so the passProperty tracking the named limbs is defensible. Noted, not charged.

verdictStatement: REJECT at 1 blocker and 0 SHOULD-FIX. This is a strong artifact and most of the attack surface holds. All six cited digests match, every verbatim carry is exact against the live DR-G08 row and naming v6, the three live-cell members are split on the correct punctuation with extras enumerated and refused, all four connectivity classes and all four executes limbs carry both fields, the reserved OD-112 numbers are named and not minted, CONTINUE-REPLAY-NOT-DESIGNED is imported from v8's own vocabulary rather than invented, and the G06, G07, G15, DR-112, DR-110, DR-113 and DR-103 splits each hold against the live rows. It fails on one axis. The artifact enumerates root as a fourth peer install surface in previewInstallSurfaces and in the matrix cross-product, and simultaneously describes root as the per-role accepted anchor and the air-gap root-chain payload member — which is v8's actual model, in which G08 install scope has three role machines and root is a property inside each. v8 gives root no role, no state instance, no audit `role` value and no CONTINUE refusal reason, and the artifact forbids itself from inventing one. Every EV passProperty fixes the platform and connectivity cardinalities and leaves the surface cardinality unstated, so the root column of the artifact's own cross-product cannot be built either way it is read. A harness specification whose declared product is exact-byte intent cannot leave the cardinality of an evidence axis undetermined.
